capsuleTopic.title: Transfiguration
capsuleTopic.subtitle: Mountain · glory · Moses · Elijah · voice
capsuleTopic.orientation: Enter the Transfiguration through each Synoptic witness, then follow the approach, changed appearance, cloud, voice, descent, valley aftermath, and later memory that Scripture places around it.
capsuleTopic.trailPrompt: Notice what each witness says about Jesus, the three disciples, Moses, Elijah, glory, fear, listening, suffering, and resurrection—and what each witness leaves unstated.
